## Prompt

Decide whether this repository change should use an existing eval, run a validator, create local eval intake, or mine sessions for missed eval triggers.

## Expected selection

use

## Why

Decision: use `aoa-eval`. Select exactly one eval route while keeping central proof, local intake, MCP access, and session evidence separate.

## Expected object

A router result that chooses select, apply, local-need, design, or session-mining and names owner boundaries.

## Boundary notes

The router is not a proof owner. It only chooses the next eval route.

## Verification hooks

Check that one subskill route is named and central `aoa-evals` proof authority remains separate.
